/** The type of the parameters of ForEach. */
export interface ForEachArgs {
  readonly i: number;
}

/** The type of the return of ForEach.Start. */
export interface ForEachStartOut {
  readonly l: readonly number[];
  readonly s: string;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Bar. */
export interface BarArgs {
  readonly a: number;
  readonly b: string;
}

/** The type of the parameter r of Bar.End. */
export type BarEndR =
  | { readonly tag: "I"; readonly value: string }
  | { readonly tag: "S" }
  | { readonly tag: "B"; readonly value: ForEachArgs };


==== client.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and
// decoding its result as the servers' JSON. Framework-neutral: hooks.ts adds
// React on top.

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc ForEach: `POST /api/foreach` on http server web-api. */
export async function forEach(args: { readonly i: number }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/foreach", {
    "i": $encInt(args.i),
  }, opts);
  return $decInt(v, "result");
}

/** Runs proc Bar: `GET /api/bar` on http server web-api. */
export async function bar(args: { readonly a: number; readonly b: string }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<string> {
  const v = await $call("GET", "/api/bar", {
    "a": $encInt(args.a),
    "b": $encString(args.b),
  }, opts);
  return $decString(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_ForEachArgs(x: $t.ForEachArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "i": $encInt(x.i),
  };
}

export function $dec_ForEachArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.ForEachArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    i: $decInt($field(o, "i", at), at + ".i"),
  };
}

export function $enc_ForEachStartOut(x: $t.ForEachStartOut): unknown {
  return {
    "l": $encList($encInt)(x.l),
    "s": $encString(x.s),
  };
}

export function $dec_ForEachStartOut(v: unknown, at: string): $t.ForEachStartOut {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    l: $decList($decInt)($field(o, "l", at), at + ".l"),
    s: $decString($field(o, "s", at), at + ".s"),
  };
}

export function $enc_BarArgs(x: $t.BarArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "a": $encInt(x.a),
    "b": $encString(x.b),
  };
}

export function $dec_BarArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.BarArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    a: $decInt($field(o, "a", at), at + ".a"),
    b: $decString($field(o, "b", at), at + ".b"),
  };
}

export function $enc_BarEndR(x: $t.BarEndR): unknown {
  if (x.tag === "I") return { "I": $encString(x.value) };
  if (x.tag === "S") return "S";
  if (x.tag === "B") return { "B": $enc_ForEachArgs(x.value) };
  return $notA(x, "BarEndR");
}

export function $dec_BarEndR(v: unknown, at: string): $t.BarEndR {
  const [tag, p] = $variant(v, at);
  if (tag === "I" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "I", value: $decString(p, at + ".I") };
  if (tag === "S" && p === $bare) return { tag: "S" };
  if (tag === "B" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "B", value: $dec_ForEachArgs(p, at + ".B") };
  return $noVariant(v, at, "BarEndR");
}

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";

/**
 * Runs proc ForEach through forEach (`POST /api/foreach` on http server
 * web-api): with args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useForEach(args?: { readonly i: number } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly i: number }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.forEach, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Bar through bar (`GET /api/bar` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useBar(args?: { readonly a: number; readonly b: string } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly a: number; readonly b: string }, string> {
  return $useCall($c.bar, args, opts);
}
